classification.difficultyReason: Translate fixed cost, unit cost and selling price into linear functions, equate them to find break-even, and represent their intercepts and intersection on a suitably scaled graph.

content.prompt: A company sells electronic devices for $\$130$ per unit. The company spent $\$60{,}000$ for the machines that produce the device, and each device requires $\$10$ worth of raw materials to produce.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Write down the cost and revenue functions $C(x)$ and $R(x)$ respectively.

answer.worked:
Let $x$ be the number of devices produced and sold. Cost and revenue are measured in dollars.
$$\begin{align*}C(x)&=60000+10x\\R(x)&=130x\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Hence, find the break-even quantity and sketch a graph showing this.

answer.short: 500 devices. The cost and revenue graphs intersect at $(500,65000)$.
answer.worked:
At break-even, cost equals revenue.
$$\begin{align*}60000+10x&=130x\\60000&=120x\\x&=500\\C(500)&=60000+10(500)\\C(500)&=65000\\R(500)&=130(500)\\R(500)&=65000\end{align*}$$
The break-even quantity is 500 devices. The lines intersect at $(500,65000)$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 12(b), answer-book PDF page 20, printed page 314
spec.description: Cost and revenue plotted from their equations with nonnegative quantity. Preserve the key's red cost line, blue revenue line, vertical cost intercept label 60000, unnumbered vertical ticks, dashed break-even guide, axis titles and lower-right legend. House palette replaces the printed pink and blue shades.
spec.mathematics: C(x)=60000+10x and R(x)=130x intersect at (500,65000). Horizontal coordinates use units of 100 devices and vertical coordinates use units of 10000 dollars.
